piCloud.title: Single sign-on
piCloud.description: Signs people in through an OpenID Connect provider, such as SAP IAS, Okta or Google, and lets in the groups or emails you choose.

issuer.title: Issuer
issuer.description: The provider's issuer URL, such as https://tenant.accounts.ondemand.com. Its redirect URI is this server's /api/plugins/oidc/callback. A client secret, if the provider needs one, comes from PI_CLOUD_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.

groupsClaim.title: Groups claim
groupsClaim.description: The ID token claim that lists the person's groups.

accessGroup.title: Access group
accessGroup.description: Members of this group can sign in. A person's first sign-in makes their user.

adminGroup.title: Admin group
adminGroup.description: Members of this group can sign in, install plugins, change their settings and restart the server.

allowedEmails.title: Allowed emails
allowedEmails.description: People with these verified emails can sign in too, for a provider that sends no groups, such as Google.

allowedDomains.title: Allowed domains
allowedDomains.description: People with a verified email at these domains, such as example.com, can sign in.

adminEmails.title: Admin emails
adminEmails.description: People with these verified emails are admins.
